name: Whoami (u-server test)
description: A tiny Go HTTP server that echoes the request it received, including the Host header and the container's own hostname. Its only purpose here is to prove the platform is service-agnostic: DNS, Traefik routing and Docker networking all work for an application that knows nothing about Project NOMAD, Meridian or u-server.
short_desc: Minimal echo server used to verify routing end to end.
author: traefik
